editorial_notes: Written about the PREVIOUS edition, from published reporting on it, to help a reader decide on the next one. No rating: the sources are news reports and organiser statements, which describe how an event was run, not how runners rated it. A score needs participant evidence -- race reports, runner blogs, attributed quotes -- and without it would be invention.
title: Indomaret Run 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Indomaret Run 2026 Review | PIK 2 Half Marathon
meta_description: Indomaret Run review: the 2025 edition at PIK 2 capped the half at 1,000 places at Rp600,000 with a 5am start. What to expect from the 2026 race.
dek: A convenience-store chain's race that is run to a proper standard: a professional race director, a route checked by elite athletes, and a half marathon capped at a thousand places. Here is how the 2025 edition worked.
verdict: Indomaret Run is better organised than its name might suggest. The 2025 edition on Sunday 23 November at PIK 2 was directed by IRace Indonesia with a route that professional athletes helped design [1], on wide, well-surfaced roads [1]. Places were deliberately limited -- 1,000 in the half marathon, 1,500 in the 10 km and 3,000 in the 5 km [2] -- and entry cost Rp600,000 for the half [2]. The unusual part is how you enter: through Indomaret shops, using the chain's Poinku membership [2]. If you are not already a member, sort that out before entries open.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The 2025 race took place on Sunday 23 November at Pantai Indah Kapuk 2, the new district on Jakarta's northern waterfront, over 5 km, 10 km and a 21 km half marathon [1][2].

Places were capped by category: 3,000 in the 5 km, 1,500 in the 10 km and 1,000 in the half marathon [2]. The half is therefore the smallest field of the three by some distance, which makes for a less crowded race than the event's total size suggests.

sections.heading: Start Times and Entry Fees
paragraphs: The three distances started in waves: the half marathon at 5.00am WIB, the 10 km at 5.15am and the 5 km at 5.30am [2]. Staggered starts keep the shorter, larger fields off the course while the half marathon runners are getting clear.
Entry was Rp400,000 for the 5 km, Rp500,000 for the 10 km and Rp600,000 for the half marathon [2]. The total prize pool across all categories was Rp300 million [2].

sections.heading: How You Enter -- Through the Shops
paragraphs: This is the detail that trips people up. Registration for the 2025 edition opened on 3 October 2025 and ran through Indomaret stores nationwide, using the chain's Poinku membership system [2].

In practice that means entering is closer to a retail transaction than an online form, and it means you need a Poinku account. If you are travelling from outside Indonesia, check how the 2026 registration will work well in advance, because a shop-and-membership process is harder to complete from abroad.

sections.heading: The Course and the Organisation
paragraphs: The event was run by IRace Indonesia, with Veddy as race director, together with PT Indomarco Prismatama, the company behind Indomaret [1]. Professional athletes were involved in setting the route, which was described as fully closed and on very good roads within the orderly PIK 2 district [1].

Water stations and medical cover were part of the published race plan [1]. The combination of a professional race management company, a closed route and roads built for a new district is what separates this from the many brand-led fun runs on the calendar.

sections.heading: Should You Enter in 2026?
paragraphs: The 2026 edition is scheduled for Sunday 22 November, based at SPIKE Airdome in PIK 2, again over 5 km, 10 km and 21 km [3]. If the format holds, expect the same staggered early starts and a capped half marathon field.

Yes, if you want a well-run Jakarta-area half on smooth, closed roads and can manage the Poinku registration. The capped field is a strength -- it keeps the half from becoming a crush -- but it also means the places can go.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the previous edition and the organisers' own announcements. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How much did the Indomaret Run half marathon cost in 2025?
faqs.answer: Rp600,000 for the half marathon, against Rp500,000 for the 10 km and Rp400,000 for the 5 km. The total prize pool across all categories was Rp300 million. Fees for the 2026 edition had not been published at the time of writing.

faqs.question: How do you register for Indomaret Run?
faqs.answer: In 2025, registration opened on 3 October through Indomaret stores across Indonesia, using the chain's Poinku membership system. That makes a Poinku account effectively a requirement, which is worth arranging early, especially from outside Indonesia.

faqs.question: What time does the Indomaret Run half marathon start?
faqs.answer: In 2025 the half marathon started at 5.00am WIB, followed by the 10 km at 5.15am and the 5 km at 5.30am. Staggered starts let the smaller half marathon field get clear before the larger shorter races set off.
